title: .zip project import fails for legal ZIP (no directories, but entries with paths)
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible on Windows 11 Pro x64 - v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf] - v4.7.2.stable.mono.official [ed1daf0bf] ### System information Windows 11 Pro x64 - Ryzen 5900 - RTX 3080 10 GiB - 128 GiB DDR - Locale en_DE - Language en_UK ### Issue description Windows 11 Pro x64 - v4.7.2.stable.official - v4.7.2.stable.mono.official [ed1daf0bf] ### Steps to reproduce #### 1. Download a .zipped project that contains nontrivial elements, e.g. gdextensions: Repro Download (9 MB, actual Godot project contents are not relevant, but it's a valid Godot .NET project) [tweens.gd-tutorial.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33428708/tweens.gd-tutorial.zip) #### 2. In the Project Manager, use the Import button to import this zip. #### 3. Observe: Failure to extract (most) files #### 4. Observe: Some files were extracted > *(but it's a far cry from all files)* ## Theories & things I tried Initial suspicion was that this is a MoTW ["Mark of the Web"](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mark_of_the_Web)(wikipedia), "Ransomware Protection", "Smart Screen" or similar issue. I turned off Folder Protection (Ransomware Protection), to no avail. ❗ **Turns out... my zip file is weird! (thanks, Microsoft!)** 1075 file entries, 0 directory entries. Each path is created by my CI on demand; all unzip tools I have, 7zip, Windows, ZipFile, ... are fine with it. It was written with `System.IO.Compression.ZipArchive` in .NET. `CreateEntry` only adds the entries (this is what my CI uses). `ZipFile.CreateFromDirectory` outputs the same. But Windows PowerShell's `Compress-Archive` does the same, so as a repro, you can pack anything with powershell to create such a "weird", perfectly legal, .zip archive. #### Workaround: Use a different packer, like 7-zip; or use `System.IO.Compression.ZipArchive.CreateEntry` for each directory as well. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Repro Download (9 MB, contents are not relevant, but it's a nontrivial Godot .NET project) [tweens.gd-tutorial.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33428708/tweens.gd-tutorial.zip)
